messages:
Priya: Heads-up — customer Zeta asks for a lightweight observability deliverable: per-route cost breakdown (tokens->$) + trace hooks at model-call boundaries so they can correlate latency spikes with cost. They want launch criteria and a clear perf/cost tradeoff. Can we scope an MVP?
Kevin: +1. Clarify: do they need 100% sampling for all routes or sampled traces with higher sampling for hot routes? Sampling matters a lot for perf.
Priya: They only need sampled traces initially, but want configurable sampling by route and a way to bump sampling for specific customers. Default should be low.
Jia: Proposal: emit structured trace events at these four points: request_received, model_infer_start, model_infer_end, response_sent. Include token counts and model id on model_infer_end. Sampling config per route + per-customer override. Example config:```yaml
tracing:
  default_sample_rate: 0.05
  route_overrides:
    "/v1/generate": 0.2
    "/v1/embeddings": 0.05
  emit_events: [request_received, model_infer_start, model_infer_end, response_sent]
```
Kevin: That looks reasonable. Two perf constraints we should set up front: added p99 latency <= 20ms on host path, and added GPU overhead <2% for the runtime path. Sampling and event payload size are primary levers.
Maria: For cost breakdown: we need token counters emitted with each model_infer_end and a canonical per-model cost table (units: $/1k tokens) stored in Console. Retention for cost attribution snapshots = 90 days by default. Also need to flag PII — ensure we never store raw prompts in traces; only token counts and model ids. KMS + audit log for private deployments.
Priya: Good call on privacy. For MVP scope suggestion: 1) Instrumentation: route-level sampling + 4 trace events for /generate & /embeddings. 2) Console surface: per-route cost waterfall (tokens x model_rate) + small trace viewer that links to a sampled trace. 3) Launch criteria: automated E2E perf tests passing, privacy checks, basic docs + one customer pilot. Anything missing?
Jia: Add: rollout policy for Dedicated/Private customers (they may want 100% sampling); we should add a toggle in Dedicated UI and a config for onprem.
Kevin: Blockers: runtime change to emit events + small schema, storage index for trace snippets (S3 or OLAP?), and cost table ingestion. Estimate: runtime + schema + basic storage = 2 devs x 2 sprints, console UI + cost calc = 1.5 devs x 2 sprints, docs + pilot = 1 sprint.
Priya: OK — owners? Jia takes runtime trace hooks + sampling API. Kevin takes E2E perf tests + storage schema. Maria owns cost model + privacy checklist. I'll own Console UX and pilot. Target: spec by Thu (next week), alpha in 3 sprints.
Maria: Quick note: we should include a small CSV uploader for customers to override model unit costs in Private. Also add a telemetry flag to exclude traces from billing-scrubbed customers.
Priya: Noted. Priortize MVP to avoid full trace search UI — link to trace details only. We'll iteratively expand.
Kevin: Also recommend we add a lightweight metric: route_token_rate (tokens/sec) into metrics backend so ops can alert before cost spikes.
Jia: I'll draft a short spec + sequence diagram and post by EOD tomorrow.
Priya: Perfect — thanks everyone. If no objections I'll schedule a 30m sync after spec to align rollout. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: none — this is a planning thread, no infra changes queued.
